status: frozen before any evidence run (freeze commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
batch_class: suffix batch WL93D (user brief 2026-11-14): frozen-checkpoint mechanism attribution for the WL93 local-operator question; no training, no new architecture; WL93 / 93A / 93B / 93C verdicts and the dual-architecture verification are preserved
question: Does geometry-dependent specialization of ECRO's learned local operator make a measurable causal contribution to sharp interreflection failure, beyond generic representation error, optimization variance and component co-adaptation?

hypotheses.H_G: functional geometry dependence of learned local operators contributes materially to sharp-transport error
hypotheses.H_R: intrinsic operator representation / optimization error dominates independently of geometry
hypotheses.H_C: co-adaptation makes isolated component interventions insufficient to attribute integrated behaviour

inspection_disclosure: E2 and E5k995 are inspected conditions (WL86-WL93C). The WL93-protocol held-out E6 (rng 93550) was never generated; it is qualified here under the frozen WL93 e6 rule BEFORE any model output on it

own.source: WL92A own_s8601 / own_s8602 (model86 ECRO, OWN-trained); local factors (c, a) are used by the single flight AND the global term

T0.source: WL93A T0_s8601 / T0_s8602 (model93.Local tied; global = frozen own_s<seed>)

models.checkpoint_check: state-dict sha256 equals the recorded values (WL92A json / WL93A json final_sha256)

physical_control: M64 = quad87 dense frozen-ER bin matrix per material (diag92.local_matrices), flat patch frame; flux-transfer form X = A z_i z_o (diag92.flux_w)
effective_operator: A_i = sum_r a[i, bo, c, r] c[i, bi, c, r] (64 x 64 x 3, patch-local bins); tied: one operator per patch for source and receiver uses

material_groups.LAM: Lambert control: material-3 patches with index rank % 13 == 0 (64 or the nearest available; deterministic)
material_groups.note: stationary patches only for cross-geometry operator comparison (box patches reported separately)

configurations.probe_basis: WL93A train-representative 16 geometries x 4 lights (training distribution)
configurations.evaluation: WL93A validation 55 geometries x 4 lights (g00010 included), E2 T0 / T1, E5k995 T0 / T1, E6 T0 / T1 (if admitted)
configurations.geometry_pairs: E2 T0<->T1, E5k995 T0<->T1, E6 T0<->T1, and validation derangement pairs (k, k+1 mod 55) in sorted order
configurations.references: B5 four-realization means (WL93A) for train-rep / validation; WL92B D fields (q, truth halves) for E2 / E5; diag92.split D fields for E6

e6_qualification.rule: the frozen WL93 protocol e6 section and prep93 e6gen / e6admit unchanged (rng 93550; WL86 stage-0 Q1-Q4 incl. Q4 SNR 4, Q6, Q7; sharp family >= 0.08 with SNR >= 4; references ER / P 8 x 8,192 spp seeds 93710 / 93730 + r + 100k; split seeds 92400 / 92405)
e6_qualification.budget: the frozen WL93 reference_attempts = 3 geometry-admissible candidates in order; stop at the first admitted; if none: conclusions limited to inspected conditions
e6_qualification.order: qualified before any intervention output on E6

probes.canonical: one-hot incident bins (all 64), flux-transfer Frobenius (WL92 metric)
probes.workload: material-level common basis V_m,use: flux-weighted PCA of incident fields at the material's patches from the probe-basis configurations (source use: s16; receiver use: flight_state(q_B5 mean)); dimension = smallest reaching 99 % energy, capped at 48; one basis per material and use, identical for every geometry

metrics.E_phys: pooled ||(A - M) P|| / ||M P|| over the material's patches and the evaluation geometries
metrics.D_geo: mean over geometry pairs of pooled ||(A(g) - A(g')) P|| / ||M P||
metrics.D_seed: pooled ||(A_s1(g) - A_s2(g)) P|| / ||M P|| over evaluation geometries (family level)
metrics.S_geo: sum_g ||(A(g) - Abar) P||^2 / sum_g ||(A(g) - M) P||^2, Abar = mean over evaluation geometries (geometry-varying share of the squared physical error)
metrics.ring: E_phys by incident polar ring (4 rings)

task_c_subspace: for evaluation incident fields x (source s16; receiver flight(q)) at S1 / S2 patches: e_in = ||(A - M) P_V x|| / ||M x||, e_out = ||(A - M)(I - P_V) x|| / ||M x||, out-of-span energy share of x; geometry drift split ||(A(g) - A(g')) P_V|| vs ||(A(g) - A(g'))(I - P_V)||; geometry-specific subspaces only as secondary

arms.C0: deployed T1 local operator at both uses
arms.C1_src / C1_rcv / C1_both: corresponding partner-geometry learned operator (T0 for the T1 conditions; derangement partner for validation) at the source use / receiver use / both uses of the single flight
arms.C2_src / C2_rcv / C2_both: frozen M64 at the source use / receiver use / both uses (C2_both = WL92B X_M12 = WL93C ORA for own)

task_b_interventions.fixed: current geometry, state rays, visibility, illumination, source encoding, the global term (computed with the deployed factors of the current geometry), evaluation samples and camera; only the single-flight local uses are substituted
task_b_interventions.tables: validation population (55, g00010 included) + train-rep + sharp configurations: source stage vs reference, single vs t2, whole vs t, global vs t - t2, signed levels
task_b_interventions.renders: E2 / E5k995 / E6 at T1 for all 7 arms; at T0 for C0 and C2_src / C2_rcv / C2_both (edit response of each arm = T1 arm - its T0 counterpart; C1 arms use C0 at T0); 2 x 4,096 spp, seeds 86600 / 86601; E_H against REF-ER (WL86 / WL92B / new E6); regions C, panel, stationary, D; region C / D edit slopes

criteria.per: per model family (own, T0) and seed; primary material S1; workload probes = the source-use AND the receiver-use material bases: a workload criterion holds only if it holds for both bases
criteria.G1_drift: D_geo(S1, workload probes) >= 0.10 AND D_geo(S1) >= 2 x D_geo(LAM), both seeds
criteria.G3_intervention: region-C E_H |C1_both - C0| >= max(noise bounds, 0.005) on >= 2 of the available T1 conditions (E2, E5k995, E6) for both seeds AND validation single-flight |C1_both - C0| >= 2 SE (paired geometry bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, seed 93004) for both seeds
criteria.GEOMETRY_SPECIALIZATION_SUPPORTED: G1 and G2 and G3 (sign of C1 - C0 reported)
criteria.REPRESENTATION_OR_OPTIMIZATION_DOMINANT: E_phys(S1, workload probes) >= 0.30 and S_geo(S1) < 0.25 for both seeds and G3 not met
criteria.COADAPTATION_LIMITED: (C2_both region-C E_H not better than C0 by max(noise, 0.005) in >= half of the T1 condition x seed cells, or validation single-flight C2_both not better than C0 by 2 SE for both seeds) OR an interaction |d_both - (d_src + d_rcv)| > max(|d_src|, |d_rcv|) on validation single flight for both seeds (d = arm - C0, C2 arms)
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: a control / test / checkpoint / correspondence failure, or none of the above, or GEOMETRY_SPECIALIZATION_SUPPORTED and REPRESENTATION_OR_OPTIMIZATION_DOMINANT disagree between families
criteria.combination: labels are evaluated independently and every satisfied label is reported (multiple mechanisms allowed); the headline is the set of satisfied labels for the primary family, with the secondary family alongside

tests.T_M64: M64 response to canonical probes equals the stored matrix rows; exact() equals einsum on probes
tests.T_IDENTITY: C0 through the substitution path reproduces the deployed model output (<= 1e-6 relative)
tests.T_SWAP: C1 arms use the partner-geometry factors (digest equal to partner, different from deployed) at exactly the intended use
tests.T_GLOBAL: global term identical in every arm and equal to the deployed global term
tests.T_ISOLATION: source-only swaps leave the receiver factors unchanged and vice versa (digests)
tests.T_FRAME: stationary patches have identical centres / normals / tangents between paired geometries; box patches flagged
tests.T_USED: doubling the swapped factors changes the output of the arm (the substituted values reach the computation)
tests.T_REPRO: C2_both of own on E2 T1 equals the WL92B X_M12 table (<= 1e-5); own deployed renders reproduce WL93A I93A_own92a renders (region-C E_H difference <= 1e-6)

scope: frozen checkpoints only; one room family, rigid edits, point lights, inspected E2 / E5 plus the qualified E6 if admitted; no training, no new representation, no threshold change, no successor
